items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Well, I'm born in Louisville. Uncle Sis and Aunt this.

ctx.x: I left home and went to Philadelphia, bought a streetcar, went to Baltimore for two cents a mile on the Baltimore, Ohio. The fella gave me a job, and I got a buck that night, and I, uh, decided to take his streetcar, and the freight train is blocking us. He's just dragging. Now, what the hell made me in the mind to get out? And I got out and grabbed that train. And I went to, uh, uh, what do they call it, Maryland. And I took an elder named that had a branch on it into Louisville. Well, I'm born in Louisville.…
Wait a minute. You done told that once before you're coming back.
